description: This header file declares functions and structures related to the upload pack operation, typically used in a version control system for handling packfile uploads.

methods.name: upload_pack
methods.description: Function to handle the upload pack request with parameters for advertising refs, stateless RPC, and timeout.

methods.name: upload_pack_v2
methods.description: Function to handle an advanced version of upload pack, taking a repository and request packet.

methods.name: upload_pack_advertise
methods.description: Function to advertise repository references using a strbuf.
